body: Native activation is blocked by newly linked private issue #354, now a dependency of #290. Independent source followup confirms a conditional credential-path logging risk in the pinned Homarr NZBGet adapter: the original response error cause retains the credential-bearing RPC Address and reaches downstream error formatting/log sinks; the decorator sanitizes only its own copy. Console text is established by source; Redis/browser log visibility is conditional on Redis logging and permission. Ordinary connection-test 401/403 payloads omit the Address, and no live leak, rejected-credential probe or secret/log read was performed. Every cited public source file agrees between tagged research and recorded OCI-source revisions, not built-image attestation. Keep native preflight Manual before credential create/update until supported transport/redaction is reconciled and reviewed. Own configuration-ownership, saved-identity and provider-Manual source corrections are in progress; no native completion or runtime permission inferred.

Both fresh independent SOURCE reviews pass with zero findings at 52eab49981b87fed11ba6a9e152ebf1eab2a07ab against fixed 795c6d082c8affd213447e0629328fb7ba9d2fe4, including the full six-file combined change. Provider definitions now follow the exact upstream 14-field consecutive-index/first-gap boundary; settings-only provider readiness remains separate from idle RPC. The reference custodian prepared the only common change, a persisted no-bypass #354 hint; its exact diff/file hashes were verified before and after the peer handoff. Config ownership/retry and saved restricted-identity controls remain intact. The same baseline test entry points remain, with no new functions/subtests. Reported combined local gate passed; reviewers did not rerun it. This is safe HELD source preparation only: #354 remains open, native preflight stays Manual before credential writes, and no native activation, runtime approval, registration or #290 completion is implied.

Fresh complete **held-source** review at `d03616aac0a2aa902097cbd7062d99abf514f891`, against fixed `795c6d082c8affd213447e0629328fb7ba9d2fe4`:

- **Standards:** PASS, zero P0–P3 findings across the entire six-file +959/-14 diff. Existing test entry points remain; the diagnostic repair adds no cases or fault triggers.
- **Spec:** PASS, zero P0–P3 findings across that same complete diff. The contextual `%w` wraps only the already-redacted `ExecSecret` error; credential registration, returned diagnostics and later display/persistence sinks retain masking.
- Ownership, symlink/duplicate-line protection, UID/GID preservation, same-login recovery, consecutive provider definitions, separate provider Manual step and pre-mutation #354 hold are unchanged. Parent verified clean local/live-remote head, exact merge-base and the only +1/-1 production change from tested `52eab499`. The owner reports the actual mandated offline gate passing; reviewers did not rerun it.

This is **diagnostic quality, not a demonstrated fix to the observed persistence failure**. Its root cause is still unknown. Keep this PR draft and #290/#354 open: native activation, useful independently captured/rendered values and lifecycle acceptance remain held. No runtime retry, merge or privacy-boundary change is authorized by either source PASS.
